ios.desc:
Being a great dad isn't about perfection—it's about presence.

Good Dad is your daily companion for mindful, intentional fatherhood. Get personalized reminders that adapt to each child's name and age, helping you show up as the dad you want to be—now available in 9 languages and designed to support families with multiple children.

PERSONALIZED FOR YOUR WHOLE FAMILY
Every reminder is tailored to each of your children. Whether you have one child or five, Good Dad creates personalized prompts for every unique relationship. Add your kids' names and birthdays, and the app customizes over 100 reminders specifically for your family—from "Ask Emma about her day" to age-appropriate prompts for toddlers, teens, and everyone in between. Plus, you'll automatically receive birthday reminders so you never miss celebrating their special days.

MULTI-CHILD MINDFUL REMINDERS
Fathers with multiple children receive reminders designed for their whole family. Each notification is personalized with the right child's name and age-appropriate guidance, helping you be intentional in every relationship and present for each unique bond you're building. New reminders help you foster healthy sibling relationships too.

DAILY MINDFUL REMINDERS
Receive gentle nudges throughout your day to be present, patient, and connected. Each reminder is a simple action you can take right now—no guilt, no pressure, just practical ways to strengthen your bond with your children.

14 THOUGHTFUL CATEGORIES
Love & Connection – Express affection and build deeper bonds
Patience & Grace – Practice understanding in challenging moments
Presence & Mindfulness – Be fully present with your kids
Understanding & Space – Give them room to grow and feel
Modeling Good Character – Lead by example in all situations
Self-Care & Reflection – Take care of yourself as a father
Fun & Play – Create joyful moments and lasting memories
Daily Routines – Make transitions smoother and more meaningful
Discipline & Boundaries – Set loving limits with intention
Education & Learning – Support their growth and curiosity
Health & Wellness – Build healthy habits together
Emotional Intelligence – Help them understand feelings
Adventure & Growth – Encourage exploration and trying new things
Sibling Relationships – Foster healthy bonds between your children

100+ ACTIONABLE REMINDERS
Browse our complete library of reminders, each crafted to help you be more present. Search by category, save your favorites, and schedule reminders that fit

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I built an app called Good Dad. It sends simple daily reminders to help me be more present with my kids.

I grew up without a father, so I didn’t really have a model for what being a present dad looks like. Now I’m a dad of two young kids and I’m figuring it out as I go, often while feeling distracted, busy, or just running on autopilot.

The app is intentionally very simple. It sends short reminders about patience, connection, and slowing down. These are the kinds of nudges I personally need when I’m scrolling, stuck in traffic, or rushing through the day. I originally built it just for myself, but decided to share it in case it helps other parents too.

I built it during naps and after bedtime. There are no ads, no tracking, and no data collection. It’s completely free.

Website: https://www.gooddad.app

iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/good-dad/id6753931366

Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.makr.gooddad&hl=en

Happy to answer questions or hear feedback.
